name: 85234 · Gilbert, AZ
findings: ZIP 85234 (Gilbert) has 149 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85234 (Gilbert) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85234 (Gilbert) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 70 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
